title: PDV Phase 13 Daedric Hircine pilot contract
notes: Phase 13 stays Hircine-only and remains outside PDV_FLST_AllDeities as a separate operational Daedric roster proof.
The structural scaffold, manager routing, EventBus routing, and MCM debug seams are live.
The direct-authoring price packet creates and wires the three Hircine price marker records without widening the CKPE bridge claim.

Runtime proof closed on 2026-05-28 for the negative pre-gate behavior, Seeker and Devoted price activation, werewolf curse-entry pressure, cure-started residue, renounce reset plus residue, and the vampire negative path.
Durable cadence lesson: same-day Hircine hunt rites are anti-repeat-scaled before stigma or piety is applied, so counted Seeker proof must use one rite on each of three in-game days.
Do not widen this packet into a second Prince, generic Daedric roster convergence, or full cross-Prince rivalry work in this tranche.

rules: the Hircine pilot quest exists with both PDV_DaedricPathBase and PDV_DaedricPath_Hircine behavior visible
the manager owns PDV_HircinePath and routes the hunt rite into the pilot
the Hircine pilot arrays read back with length 10
the Hircine price packet exists and Price_Seeker / Price_Devoted / Price_Champion point at the tracked spells

positive: one Hircine hunt rite increments commitment signals and stigma
the third qualifying hunt rite on separate in-game days opens Hircine piety and Seeker price activation
later multi-day hunt rites can advance Hircine into Devoted price activation
werewolf curse-entry adds Hircine pressure and cure leaves Nord residue behind recovery
renouncing the path clears active piety, starts residue recovery, and leaves the curse posture readable
negative: without enough commitment signals, hunt rites do not award Hircine piety
same-day repeated hunt rites can reach signal-count 3 while still staying below ThresholdSeeker because the shared repeat multiplier scales the rite before piety is applied
non-Hircine Aedric paths do not accidentally consume the Hircine signal
vampire state does not receive the werewolf-favoring Hircine gain multiplier
